item.text:
This pass found a ninth defect — the most trivial remote crash yet.

**Finding 9: a peer message with no destination crashes the NodeHost**

`(*messageHandler).HandleMessageBatch` ([nodehost.go](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_20-19-30-dragonboat_raft-baseline/work/nodehost.go:2117)) panics when any request in an incoming batch has `To == 0`:

```
HandleMessageBatch panicked on a peer message with To == 0: to field not set, Heartbeat
--- FAIL: TestAuditMessageWithoutDestinationDoesNotPanic
```

`transport.handleRequest` only checks the deployment ID and bin version (both default/guessable) before handing the batch to the handler, so a batch containing a single destinationless message kills the process. Logging a warning and skipping the message in the fix-verification copy makes the reproduction pass.

**State**

Nine findings, all reproduced on the unmodified tree, all fixed in `audit/diag-fixes/`:

- F1 `(*nodeUser).ReadIndex` misses the engine wakeup
- F2 `handleCandidateReadIndex` records a dropped ReadIndex twice
- F3 `pb.Update.HasUpdate` ignores `DroppedReadIndexes`
- F4 `plugin/chan.ChanTransportFactory.Validate` panics
- F5 logger cache ignores the monkey flag
- F6 crafted batch/message frames panic the process (live reproduction)
- F7 short first snapshot chunk panics the receiver
- F8 forged `HasFileInfo` chunk panics on save
- F9 peer message with `To == 0` panics the handler

F6–F9 are the same class — peer input on the transport receive path answered with `panic`/`panicNow` instead of an error; the report groups them with a common-pattern table. The remaining fix set is regression-checked against the upstream suites (root, transport incl. TLS, rsm, raftpb all pass).

33 audit tests: 22 negative-result/characterisation passes, 11 deliberate reproductions. [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_20-19-30-dragonboat_raft-baseline/work/report.md) (935 lines) documents all nine; the audited tree remains byte-identical to `../source`.
